principles: Do not use images or bundled image assets as a required text-rendering or layout dependency.
Do not disable system font scaling for normal body/content text.
Allow meaningful labels, validation messages, addresses, and descriptions to wrap; any deliberate visual truncation must expose the complete value via a nearby detail view or accessible label.
Tables may use an explicit horizontally scrollable container where wrapping would destroy data readability; body-level horizontal clipping is not an acceptable substitute.
Currency code, business timezone, fare rules and financial rounding remain backend/product contract decisions; layout formatting does not define them.
